payload.reason: The evidence provides specific baseline methods used in the experiments, including logistic regression, GBDT, and RNN, which are compared against the proposed multi-task learning method.

claims.text: The baseline methods include logistic regression (LR), GBDT (Gradient Boosted Decision Trees), and RNN (Recurrent Neural Networks).
The official baseline provided by Duolingo is a simple logistic regression using all the meta and context information from the datasets.
GBDT is described as the best method among tree ensemble methods, utilizing existing and manually constructed features.
RNN is noted as the best method among sequence modeling methods.
